definitions: To attempt a task that is too big or difficult to handle.
To take on more responsibility than one can manage.
examples: She bit off more than she could chew with that project.
I think he's biting off more than he can chew by working two full-time jobs.
lemma: to bite off more than one can chew
synonyms: to get in over one's head
source: to bite off more than one can chew
